Statistics of [[Ekstraklasa]] for the 1936 season.

==Overview==
The championship was contested by 10 teams, and [[Ruch Chorzów|Ruch Hajduki Wielkie]] (currently Ruch Chorzów) won the title.

Season's [[Legia Warsaw]] relegation from Ekstraklasa, was its only decline from the first tier of the [[Polish football league system]] in its more than 100-year history.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://legia.com.pl/pl/13134,Lata_19361946_najtrudniejsze_chwile_w_dziejach_Legii.html|title=Lata 1936-1946 - najtrudniejsze chwile w dziejach Legii|access-date=2020-11-28|archive-date=2020-02-23|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200223012626/http://legia.com.pl/pl/13134,Lata_19361946_najtrudniejsze_chwile_w_dziejach_Legii.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>
